blocks.x: Architecture, security posture and audit evidence for Tele Medicine Platform — zero-trust & ai security platform from Achala IT Solutions.

The platform separates three planes. The data plane carries workload (identity, posture, segmentation, workload identity, versioned rules with CI testing, policy-as-code with fix-the-pipeline flows); the control plane carries policy and orchestration (injection filtering, containment, red-teaming, workforce/CIAM/machine lifecycle); the evidence plane carries audit, replay and conformity documentation — the plane most vendors skip and every regulator asks about.

Sentinel assumes breach and designs for audit: purple-team validation of segmentation, restore-tested backups, AI red-team suites with findings-to-fix tracking. The platform's own controls are SOC 2 Type II audited and ISO 27001 certified.

items: platform controls audited; evidence exports mapped to customer audit scopes.
DORA, HIPAA-ready pods, PCI DSS support and GDPR data-residency options where the estate requires them.
NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 control mapping; EU AI Act documentation generated for high-risk deployments.

blocks.x: The control plane is sized for enterprise scale: decision and orchestration paths carry published latency budgets, and the evidence plane writes append-only logs that never sit on the hot path.

items: deployed inside your cloud landing zone; customer-managed keys; your SIEM receives telemetry.
operated by our pods under SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 with quarterly evidence exports.
Twinverse and Sentinel patterns extend to plant, store and site estates with signed boot and 62443-aligned segmentation.

blocks.x: SIEM/XDR, SPIFFE/SPIRE, OPA, IdPs/IGA, CNAPP tooling. Adapters to core systems (CRM, ERP, core banking, EHR, WMS/MES, SCADA) are versioned contracts — one schema change propagates to every consumer.
